newsitem.title: GERMANY: German aluminium foil sales down in Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: German aluminium foil sales down in Jan-July.

text.p: Sales of aluminium foil and thin strip in the first seven months of 1996 were down nine percent on the same 1995 period at 110,500 tonnes, German aluminium industry association GDA said.
Armin Weinhold, chairman of GDA's foil and strip division in a statement said earlier expectations of slightly higher 1996 sales would probably not materialise.
"The recovery process expected for the first half of 1996 has been below our expectations," he said.
Sales values in Jan-July dropped 3.8 percent to 1.25 billion marks.
Out of the 110,500 tonne total, exports declined by eleven percent to 72,100 while domestic sales were 4.8 percent lower at 38,400 tonnes.
New orders in the first eight months were 4.5 percent above those received in the same 1995 period but that was a historically bad year, the statement said.
GDA's foil and strip division groups 22 companies which supply the confectionery, food, drinks and pharmaceutical industries.
